tip: Insider tip: Hit the low early flows on Taneycomo (before ~noon). Drift or wade seams with 2-lb test and a Berkley Pink PowerWorm or 1/16-oz marabou micro jig (black/sculpin/olive with orange head) or hang a zebra midge (#16-20 red/black) under an indicator.
